bio: Here at Stapferstube, a well-known Zurich eatery, Italian dishes such as tris di pasta della casa, gamberoni aglio olio peperoncino, and brasato di manzo al Barolo are a hit with diners. In this vibrant and welcoming restaurant, regulars and first-time guests alike are treated to Mediterranean hospitality and a cosy atmosphere. Their quick lunch at a reasonable price is also popular....
